_marker: THE NAMED DIVERGENCES — every place the documented chain does NOT re-derive the committed corpus, with the reviewed cause. Read by scripts/corpus-reproducible-check.ts: an UNNAMED divergence refuses, and a row whose divergence has since been FIXED refuses too (a stale row is as dead as a missing one). Rows are not permission to drift — they are the admission, on the record, that a fact in the corpus came from somewhere the chain cannot reach.

altitude.cause: HAND-EDITED CAPTURE RECORD, NOT A HAND-EDITED CONTRACT — the edit is one layer further up than the polaris row above, and that is what makes it worse. extract/computed/out/altitude/chip/enriched.contract.json — a CAPTURE OUTPUT, the machine-written product of a headless browser run — carries on `main` a `type` prop whose enum is ["default","squared"], a Figma value map {default: "Default", squared: "Squared"}, and the hand-written sentence "FC-ENUM-HOLE: capture seed only listed squared; the absent-attribute (pill) rendering is the developed default". divider carries the same class (`default` horizontal rule alongside `vertical`). The seed lists only `squared`, and no capture can see the pill: in Altitude the default rendering is the ABSENCE of the attribute, which the capture plane spells as the `unset` pseudo-value and this library forbids as a real enum member. MEASURED on this branch by running the eval's own promotion into a throwaway dir and diffing every produced file: exactly two differ, chip and divider, and the whole diff is that enum member, its value map, its description, plus `statePreviews` false (committed) vs true (fresh promote). WHY THE DIVERGENCE APPEARED NOW: this branch (proof/altitude-badge) re-captured the whole altitude library honestly, so the patched capture record was overwritten with what the component actually renders. The contracts were then restored to their `main` bytes so the badge proof would introduce no canvas regression — which is why the committed contracts no longer re-derive. Nothing upstream is broken; the break is entirely between the record and the contract, exactly as polaris's is. THE DOOR THAT WOULD CARRY THEM ALREADY EXISTS and is not hypothetical: packages/cli/src/promote.ts's authored-facts sidecar, which examples/mui and examples/tailwind already use via ds-library.json `authored`. Its own marker names this exact pathology as the defect it was built to close — "until 2026-08-24 this fact was HAND-WRITTEN INTO THE CAPTURE RECORD ... so the record claimed a provenance no run reproduced". altitude names no `authored` file. Routing chip's and divider's enum holes through an examples/altitude/authored-facts.json (`edit` on the prop's type.enum and bindings.figma.values, `set.fields` for the description) turns both hand-edits into declared INPUTS and retires this row. That is a bounded, mechanical change, and it is deliberately NOT made here: it belongs beside the seed fix, not inside a proof that one badge reached the canvas. This row is not permission to drift. It is the admission, on the record, that two facts in the altitude corpus came from somewhere the chain cannot reach.

polaris.cause: HAND-EDITED PROMOTED CONTRACTS WITH NO AUTHORED-FACTS LEDGER — and the capture half now proves the edits are the WHOLE story: polaris's twelve capture records re-derive 12/12 from its committed seed + config + sandbox, so nothing upstream is wrong. The break is entirely between the record and the contract. polaris is the one library whose ds-library.json names no `authored` file, and eight of its committed contracts carry edits the promoter does not produce: developed defaults (avatar `initials: "TP"` and `withInitials: true`, progress-bar `progress: 40`), FC-ENUM-HOLE (button `tone` gains the developed `default` value and its `{variant}.none` paint paths), FC-SVG-ROTATION (spinner glyphs gain `transform: rotate(90deg)`), console-loop VISUAL fixes (checkbox/radio-button backdrops swap minted `tokensByProp` for literal per-axis border+fill; the indeterminate glyph's `fill` is rebound to icon-6 white), a changed sample string (checkbox "Save this product" -> "Save this information"), and the minted leaves that go orphan or appear because of those. Each edit names its own cause inline in the contract, so none is a mystery about WHAT — but none is an INPUT, so the chain cannot produce them and `promote-generalization` has never covered polaris. The door that would carry them already exists (packages/cli/src/promote.ts authored facts: `edit` for the enum/default/description moves, `set.fields` for `literalsByProp` and `meter`, `set.declared` for the glyph rotation, `add` for the FC-ENUM-HOLE enum value, `prune` for the leaves that go orphan). Routing them is a bounded, mechanical round of its own and is NOT done here; this row exists so the gap is machine-checked rather than silent.

mui/tooltip.cause: THE CAPTURE REFUSES ITSELF — the sharpest row in this ledger, and an HONEST refusal by the engine's own determinism self-check. MUI's Tooltip mounts a Popper whose x offset is computed from the trigger's measured position, and two sweeps of the SAME configuration in one session disagree by 3px (19 vs 16). `extract/computed/run.ts` requires double-run byte-identity and stops. So `extract/computed/out/mui/tooltip` cannot be re-derived by anyone, on any machine, today — not because a fact was hand-written, but because the subject is not deterministic under the documented recipe. Cure: pin the Popper's placement in the capture config (a fixed anchor, the way the openDriver already pins `open`) so the offset stops being a function of layout timing, then recapture. Until then this record is a measurement nobody can repeat, and this row says so.
